notes.sowing: Plant dormant plants in early spring, about 4 weeks before your last frost, once the soil can be worked. Set the middle of the crown at soil level with the roots fully buried: too deep and it rots, too shallow and it dries out.
notes.care: Pinch off flowers on June-bearing plants through the first season, and on day-neutral types for the first few weeks. Mulch with straw once plants are dormant and nights stay below {c:4}, and cover open blossoms on frosty nights. Renovate June-bearing beds after harvest and start a new bed every 3 to 4 years.
notes.harvest: Pick fully red berries every two to three days, with the cap on. June-bearing types crop for about three weeks in the year after planting; day-neutral types can fruit from midsummer of the first year.
